header.running_head: Honouring the Weak and Poor Muslims

blocks.text: do so." It was then that Allaah revealed the verse:

blocks.arabic_text: وَأَنْذِرْ بِهِ الَّذِيْنَ يَخَافُوْنَ أَنْ يُّحْشَرُوْا إِلٰى رَبِّهِمْ لَيْسَ لَهُمْ مِّنْ دُوْنِهٖ وَلِيٌّ وَّلَا شَفِيْعٌ لَّعَلَّهُمْ يَتَّقُوْنَ وَلَا تَطْرُدِ الَّذِيْنَ يَدْعُوْنَ رَبَّهُمْ بِالْغَدٰوةِ وَالْعَشِيِّ يُرِيْدُوْنَ وَجْهَهٗ مَا عَلَيْكَ مِنْ حِسَابِهِمْ مِّنْ شَيْءٍ وَّمَا مِنْ حِسَابِكَ عَلَيْهِمْ مِّنْ شَيْءٍ فَتَطْرُدَهُمْ فَتَكُوْنَ مِنَ الظّٰلِمِيْنَ
blocks.text: Use it (the Qur'aan) to warn those who fear that they will be gathered before their Rabb without any helper or intercessor, so that they may grow concerned. Do not drive away those (poor Sahabah (RA)) who call (worship) their Rabb morning and evening, seeking His pleasure. You are not accountable at all for them (for their inner condition), nor are they at all accountable (responsible) for you, (there is therefore no reason) that (permits) you (to) drive them away and to (thereby) become of the wrong-doers (by doing this).[^1]
Rasulullaah ﷺ Honours Hadhrat Ibn Umm Maktoom (RA) After being Chided

Discussing the verse عَبَسَ وَتَوَلّٰى[^2], Hadhrat Anas (RA) says that Hadhrat Ibn Umm Maktoom (RA) (who was blind) once came to Rasulullaah ﷺ while Rasulullaah ﷺ was speaking to Ubay bin Khalaf (he was one of the leaders of the Quraysh and Rasulullaah ﷺ was inviting him to Islaam). When Rasulullaah ﷺ ignored Hadhrat Ibn Umm Maktoom (RA) (thinking that he could always see to him later), Allaah revealed the verses:
He (Rasulullaah ﷺ) frowned and turned away because a blind man came to him...
After this, Rasulullaah ﷺ always honoured Hadhrat Ibn Umm Maktoom (RA).[^3]

Hadhrat Aa'isha (RA) reports that the Surah[^4] was revealed with reference to the blind Sahabi Hadhrat Ibn Umm Maktoom (RA) who once came to Rasulullaah ﷺ saying, "Guide me." Because Rasulullaah ﷺ was busy speaking (giving Da'wah) to one of the leaders of the Mushrikeen, he ignored Hadhrat Ibn Umm Maktoom (RA). Devoting his attention to the Mushrik instead, Rasulullaah ﷺ asked him, "Do you see anything wrong in what I have told you?" The man admitted that he saw nothing wrong with it. It was on this occasion that Allaah revealed the Surah:
